arguments.where_clause: card_id IN (SELECT id FROM cards WHERE card_brand = 'Amex')
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction made with an American Express card, matched through the card's brand in the cards table.
assumptions: 'American Express' is taken to be the card_brand value 'Amex'.
The rule covers all transactions on Amex cards in the full data range, regardless of card type, transaction type or amount.
